searchText: <@403707149043105803> can you add a readiness list with the client that are good to go for Osaka-0. Reth is ready, code is on main Nethermind is ready and rebased, besu etc. Would love if we can get a live long-running devnet up ASAP, after a Kurtosis one locally What if we went with PeerDAS enabled and just picked 1 CL; would that make it easier to setup up? Kurtosis has issues, the package is only set up to produce Pectra or Fulu, not a hybrid Electra/Osaka. So any kurtosis network will need to decide if we want the PeerDAS or FOCIL protoypes alingside it, addin un-needed complexity. Which single CL would be the most stable? I'm unfamiliar with their current dev processes.
